params.body:
## What was wrong

On Insights > Activity, hovering a bar showed two dark bubbles with the same text, one slightly offset behind the other (for example "do. 1 okt. 52 (lopend)" twice).

The bars carried their readout in `data-tip`, and `insights.css` drew the chart's own bubble from it (`::after { content: attr(data-tip) }`). `data-tip` is also the attribute the app-wide tooltip (`components/ui/tip.blade.php`) listens to through event delegation on the document, so it added a second bubble on `<body>` for the same element.

Fixes bevinding twee-leesvensters-op-een-staaf.

## What changes

- The readout of a bar now lives in `data-reading`, which only the chart's CSS reads. The app-wide tooltip no longer answers a bar.
- Every bar and grid cell gets `role="img"` and an `aria-label` with the same reading, so the value has an accessible name without a second bubble.
- The chart bubble also answers `:focus-visible` for the plain bars and grid cells, as it already did for the stacked bars (which stay focusable with `tabindex="0"`).

## Which charts

Checked each chart type in a browser (hover a mark, count visible bubbles):

| Chart | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Activity: daily/monthly bars of the chosen measure | 2 | 1 |
| Activity: stacked bars per channel (hover and keyboard focus) | 2 | 1 |
| Activity: reference strips per channel | 2 (same markup) | 1 |
| Activity: weekday by hour grid | 2 | 1 |
| Overview: lines, bars, stacked bars, sell-time distribution, stocklist size (SVG, `.ins-tip`) | 1 | 1 |
| My insights: stacked bars (readout line under the chart) | no bubble of its own | unchanged |

## Tests

- `ABarYouCanReadANumberOffTest::test_a_bar_shows_one_bubble_and_not_two`: no mark with a readout carries `data-tip`, each has an `aria-label`, and the stylesheet draws no bubble from `data-tip`.
- `resources/js/insights-one-bubble.test.js` (vitest): runs the real app-wide tooltip script in jsdom; it answers `data-tip`, and leaves a bar with `data-reading` alone on hover and on focus. Also pins that none of the insights chart sources hands a mark to the app-wide tooltip or a `title`.
- Full PHP suite (2656 tests), vitest, eslint and PHPStan pass locally.
params.title: One bubble per bar on the activity charts
